question: Should `models.providers.*.request.headers.*` use the same header-name sensitivity heuristic as top-level provider headers, allowing static routing headers like `Wafer-ZDR` while relying on sensitive names such as `Authorization` to stay flagged?
rationale: The code change is mechanically narrow, but it changes which plaintext request headers security audit reports or suppresses, so automation cannot choose the acceptable false-negative boundary.

options.title: Approve shared request-header policy
options.body: Treat request headers like provider headers, merge this focused alignment after the draft is ready, and accept the name-heuristic tradeoff.

options.title: Tighten before merge
options.body: Require a narrower documented-static-header allowlist or an expanded sensitive-name classifier before suppressing request-header findings.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it while maintainers design a different request-header audit contract.

recommendation.title: Approve shared request-header policy
recommendation.body: Treat request headers like provider headers, merge this focused alignment after the draft is ready, and accept the name-heuristic tradeoff.
